subject: Future Tech
title: Quantum Dots in Action
description: A quick, practical guide to Quantum Dots in Action.

hook.text: Quantum dots are semiconductor crystals so small they glow.

buildup.text: At 2 nm, they glow blue. At 6 nm, they glow red.

discovery.text: Samsung's QLED TVs use quantum dots to produce incredibly vivid colors.

twist.text: Early quantum dots used toxic cadmium.

climax.text: Quantum dots now tag cancer cells for imaging, track drug delivery, and convert sunlight in next-gen solar panels.

punchline.text: Nanoscale crystals that glow on command. Size is the switch.

quiz.question: What determines the color a quantum dot emits?
